design: lambda_adv in {0, 2}, seeds {42, 52, 62}; ISIC split grouped by lesion_id (StratifiedGroupKFold 5-fold, random_state 42, first fold = test; same again on train+val for val). Everything else identical to Phase 3. Phase 2 checkpoint reuse disabled.
null_lesion_id_policy: each image with null lesion_id is its own group (kept). 2084 of 25331 ISIC images (8.23%).
comparison: image-level Phase 3 runs at the same lambda and seeds {42, 52, 62}; not the five-seed mean

pattern_checks.leakage_falls: mean leakage bal acc lower at lambda=2 than lambda=0
pattern_checks.id_bal_not_lower_by_0.02: mean ID bal acc at lambda=2 minus lambda=0 > -0.02
pattern_checks.ood_ece_rises: mean OOD ECE (pad_heldout, 6-class restricted) higher at lambda=2
pattern_checks.maha_above_0.5_at_0_below_at_2: pad_heldout Maha AUROC > 0.5 at lambda=0 and < 0.5 at lambda=2
pattern_checks.all_five_detectors_fall: Maha, cosine, kNN, MSP, Energy on pad_heldout all lower at lambda=2
pattern_checks.fitz_above_0.5_at_0_below_at_2: Fitzpatrick17k Maha AUROC > 0.5 at lambda=0 and < 0.5 at lambda=2

decision: pattern unchanged iff every check has the same truth value for the lesion-level and image-level runs; otherwise pattern changes

amendments.requirement: At every lambda report (i) the class distribution of the lesion-grouped ISIC test split against the image-level one, (ii) every detector AUROC unrestricted and with the ID side reweighted to the image-level class distribution (w_c = p_image(c)/p_lesion(c), OOD weight 1), and (iii) the pattern checks on the reweighted values.
amendments.reason: Without the reweighted column a change is ambiguous between leakage removed and class mix changed (results/paperB/r2/disjoint_reweight).
amendments.known_before_results: lesion-level test label counts (fixed by the split): NV 2575, MEL 904, BCC 664, BKL 525, AK 174, SCC 126, VASC 51, DF 48; image-level: identical except BCC 665, AK 173.
amendments.primary_verdict_unchanged: the pre-committed verdict remains on the unrestricted values; the reweighted pattern is reported beside it
